title: Raw Ideas in the Fuzzy Front End: Verbosity Increases Perceived Creativity
authors: Laura J. Kornish; Sharaya M. Jones
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Seven studies (online experiments and analyses of existing crowdsourced idea ratings) relating idea length to perceived creativity; OLS of ratings on length and experimental condition.
design_notes: study 1-7 folders with R scripts, e.g. lm(Creativity ~ LengthScaled + LengthScaledSq) and lm(crtv ~ lengthsMC * cond). No panel, no treatment timing.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
